newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain eyes resolution of job mkt reform by March.
newsitem.headline: Spain eyes resolution of job mkt reform by March.

text.p: Unions and employers have until around the start of March to reach agreement on the reform of Spain's labour market or the government will step in, Secretary General for Employment Manuel Pimentel told Reuters on Thursday.
But the administration has not set a specific date upon which it would see the need to impose some kind of plan if the two sides fail to strike a deal.
"There's no concrete time limit for us to enter negotiations, but by around the beginning of March we'd expect to see something from the talks," Pimentel said.
Trades unions and employers are discussing ways to liberalise a rigid jobs market and create employment, and are next set to meet on Friday.
"We've set out some very wide fields for discussion, including things such as job stability. We think that both sides are still prepared to negotiate, and that's the important thing," Pimentel said.
According to Labour Ministry figures, unemployment was at 13.82 percent in December, the highest rate in Europe.
